questions.question: With which organisation did ISRO sign an MoU for developing MATSYA-6000?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**NIOT**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• ISRO signs MoU with NIOT for submersible spherical vessel MATSYA-6000.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**ISRO’s Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre (VSSC)** has signed an **MoU** with the **National Institute of Ocean Technology (NIOT)**.

 
 
• 
 
They will jointly develop a **submersible spherical vessel named *MATSYA-6000***.

 
 
• 
 
**MATSYA-6000** is a **Human-Occupied Vehicle (HOV)** designed to carry **humans up to 6 km underwater**.

 
 
• 
 
It is a major component of **‘Samudrayaan’**, which is part of the **Deep Ocean Mission** under the **Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES)**.

 
 
• 
 
**VSSC** is responsible for the **design and material development** of the HOV.

 
 
• 
 
The HOV will enable **India’s first manned deep-sea mission**, marking a milestone in ocean exploration.

questions.question: Which Indian company signed an agreement with Dassault Aviation to manufacture Rafale fuselages?
questions.solution:

• 
 
**Dassault Aviation** (France) and **Tata Advanced Systems** (India) signed **4 agreements** to jointly manufacture **Rafale fuselages**.

 
 
• 
 
This is the **first time** Rafale fuselage production will happen **outside France**.

 
 
• 
 
A **new facility** will be set up in **Hyderabad**, India.

 
 
• 
 
The project marks a **major step** in India’s **aerospace manufacturing** and global **supply chain** role.

 
 
• 
 
The first fuselage sections are expected by **2028**.

 
 
•

questions.question: India and UK sign historic Free Trade Agreement, set to boost annual trade by $34 bn. Which UK leader was involved in signing the FTA with India?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Keir Starmer**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India and UK sign historic Free Trade Agreement, set to boost annual trade by $34 bn.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**India and the UK signed a landmark Free Trade Agreement (FTA)** in **2025**, aiming to boost **bilateral trade by USD 34 billion annually**.

 
 
• 
 
This is the **UK’s largest trade deal** since **Brexit** (leaving the EU in 2020).

 
 
• 
 
The agreement was signed by **Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal** and **UK’s Secretary of State for Business and Trade Jonathan Reynolds**.

 
 
• 
 
The signing followed bilateral talks between **PM Narendra Modi** and **UK PM Keir Starmer** in **London**.

 
 
• 
 
This is **India’s first major bilateral FTA with a developed country** in over **10 years**.

 
 
• 
 
**99% of Indian products** will receive **duty-free access** to the **UK market**.

 
 
• 
 
It covers key Indian exports like **leather, textiles, garments, footwear**.

 
 
• 
 
In return, the UK gets tariff cuts on items like **whisky and cars**.

 
 
• 
 
The **target is to double India-UK trade to USD 120 billion by 2030**.

 
 
• 
 
The deal also includes a **social security agreement**, helping **Indian companies save on double social security contributions** when sending employees to the UK.

 
 
• 
 
The **UK is India’s 6th-largest investor** with **USD 36 billion total investments**.

 
 
• 
 
**~1,000 Indian companies operate in the UK**, employing **over 1,00,000 people** and investing around **USD 2 billion**.

 
 
• 
 
**India’s exports to the UK rose** by **12.6% to USD 14.5 billion (2024–25)**, while **imports rose** by **2.3% to USD 8.6 billion**.

questions.question: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) has signed an MoU with which Russian company for the production of SJ-100 civil commuter aircraft in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**United Aircraft Corporation.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) has signed an MoU with Russia’s United Aircraft Corporation (UAC) for the production of SJ-100 civil commuter aircraft in India, marking a major milestone for indigenous civil aviation manufacturing.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The SJ-100 is expected to revolutionize short-haul connectivity under the Government’s UDAN Scheme.**
 
• **This will be the first complete passenger aircraft to be manufactured in India, aligning with the ‘Aatmanirbhar Bharat’ vision.**
 
• **The collaboration is a significant step in building domestic capability in aircraft design and production.**
 
• **Defence Minister Rajnath Singh termed the MoU a game changer for India’s civil aviation sector.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL)__

 __
 
• Established: 1940
 
• Headquarters: Bengaluru, Karnataka
 
• A leading aerospace and defence PSU engaged in the design, development, and manufacture of aircraft and helicopters.
 
 
 
• United Aircraft Corporation (UAC)__
 __
 
• Founded: 2006
 
• Headquarters: Moscow, Russia
 
• Parent Organisation: Rostec State Corporation
 
• Specializes in the development and manufacturing of civil and military aircraft including the Sukhoi Superjet (SJ-100).
 
 
 
• UDAN Scheme__
 __
 
• Full Form: Ude Desh ka Aam Naagrik
 
• Launched: 2016
 
• Aims to enhance regional air connectivity and make air travel affordable to common citizens.
 
 
 
• Impact__
 
 
• The SJ-100 project will boost local manufacturing, create job opportunities, and strengthen private participation in aviation.
 
• It represents a major step toward self-reliance in civil aircraft production.

questions.question: The National Council for Educational Research and Training (NCERT) has signed an MoU with which institution to strengthen educational research, development, and technology integration?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**IIT-Madras.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **NCERT signed a Memorandum of Understanding with IIT-Madras in New Delhi to enhance educational research, teacher training, and integration of technology-driven learning tools.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The collaboration aligns with the goals of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 to promote innovation and digital transformation in education.**
 
• **It aims to introduce Information Technology (IT), Artificial Intelligence (AI), and Machine Learning (ML)-enabled learning systems in schools.**
 
• **The partnership focuses on research, data analytics, and the creation of multilingual digital learning platforms.**
 
• **The MoU supports the development of advanced educational resources and teacher training modules using technology integration.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• NCERT__

 __
 
• Established: 1961
 
• Headquarters: New Delhi
 
• Functions: Educational research, curriculum design, and teacher training under the Ministry of Education.
 
 
 
• IIT-Madras__
 __
 
• Established: 1959
 
• Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu
 
• Renowned for innovations in AI, Machine Learning, and education technology research.
 
 
 
• National Education Policy (NEP) 2020__
 
 
• Aims to transform India’s education system through multidisciplinary learning, digital inclusion, and skill-based education.
 
• Promotes collaboration between academia and technology institutions to modernize educational frameworks.

questions.question: India recently signed an MoU with the International Labour Organisation (ILO) to support the creation of which international framework aimed at improving job classification and skills comparability across borders?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**IRCO (International Reference Classification of Occupations)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India Signs MoU with ILO for International Job Classification.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
India has signed a **Memorandum of Understanding (MoU)** with the **International Labour Organisation (ILO)** to create the **International Reference Classification of Occupations (IRCO)**.

 
 
• 
 
This MoU aims to improve **global comparability of skills**, helping **Indian workers** gain access to international employment opportunities.

 
 
• 
 
The agreement was formalized in **Geneva** with key figures like **Ambassador Arindam Bagchi** and **ILO Director-General Gilbert F. Houngbo**.

 
 
• 
 
**Digital platforms** such as **National Career Service (NCS)** and **e-Shram Portal** are central to India's domestic **employment reforms**.

 

 
• **International Labour Organisation (ILO)**: Founded in **1919**, headquartered in **Geneva**, Switzerland. It sets international labor standards and promotes social justice.
